key: ultima iii - exodus (1986)(origin)[a4]/Ultima III - Exodus (1986)(Origin)[a4].adf:EXODUS:0:013A
name: close_handles_and_reply

name: raise_alert_and_exit

key: ultima iii - exodus (1986)(origin)[a4]/Ultima III - Exodus (1986)(Origin)[a4].adf:EXODUS:129:0000
name: parse_string_table
description: Splits a command line into tokens separated by spaces or double quotes, stores a pointer to each token in a table, and terminates tokens in place. When no tokens are found it opens the console window named in the text and sets up the current task; otherwise it takes the current input and output and opens the named file, reporting an error for an unterminated quoted string.

key: ultima iii - exodus (1986)(origin)[a4]/Ultima III - Exodus (1986)(Origin)[a4].adf:EXODUS:94:0000
name: allocate_and_init_block
description: Allocates a memory block sized from its argument plus twelve bytes, records that size inside the block, calls a routine with the program's global value and the block, and returns the usable address past the header. It returns zero if allocation fails.

key: ultima iii - exodus (1986)(origin)[a4]/Ultima III - Exodus (1986)(Origin)[a4].adf:EXODUS:94:0060
name: allocate_block_or_minus_one
description: Calls the block allocator with its argument and returns the block address if that succeeded, otherwise minus one.

key: ultima iii - exodus (1986)(origin)[a4]/Ultima III - Exodus (1986)(Origin)[a4].adf:EXODUS:94:0078
name: return_minus_one
description: Returns minus one and does nothing else.

key: ultima iii - exodus (1986)(origin)[a4]/Ultima III - Exodus (1986)(Origin)[a4].adf:EXODUS:94:00B4
name: free_linked_memory_blocks
description: Walks a singly linked list whose head is held in a global variable, freeing each node with the size stored in that node, until the list ends.

key: ultima iii - exodus (1986)(origin)[a4]/Ultima III - Exodus (1986)(Origin)[a4].adf:EXODUS:94:00E8
name: append_node_to_list
description: Appends a node to a list whose first word holds the head and second word the tail. The new node's back pointer is set to the old tail and its forward pointer is cleared, the old tail is linked to it, and it becomes the tail, also becoming the head when the list was empty.

key: ultima iii - exodus (1986)(origin)[a4]/Ultima III - Exodus (1986)(Origin)[a4].adf:EXODUS:2:0000
name: get_file_size
description: Locks the named file, examines it to read its size field, unlocks it, and returns that size, or zero if the file cannot be locked. If the stack limit check fails it instead falls through to the same argument setup as the command-line entry.

key: ultima iii - exodus (1986)(origin)[a4]/Ultima III - Exodus (1986)(Origin)[a4].adf:EXODUS:2:006C
name: transfer_file_contents
description: Calls a routine for the named file and, when its result is nonzero, either writes that many bytes from the buffer to the file or reads that many bytes into it, depending on whether the mode argument is minus one or minus two. It closes the file afterwards and returns the transferred count, or minus one if nothing was done.

key: ultima iii - exodus (1986)(origin)[a4]/Ultima III - Exodus (1986)(Origin)[a4].adf:EXODUS:2:015E
name: restore_saved_view
description: When the stack check passes, it shifts a saved set of view pointers back into place and loads the view. Otherwise it performs the same command-line argument setup as the other entry routines before returning.

key: ultima iii - exodus (1986)(origin)[a4]/Ultima III - Exodus (1986)(Origin)[a4].adf:EXODUS:2:01CC
name: setup_custom_display
description: Opens the graphics library, opens and closes a temporary window, closes Workbench, removes the current task and installs an interrupt server. It then allocates and clears two bitmap buffers, builds the viewport and copper lists, and loads the new view.

key: ultima iii - exodus (1986)(origin)[a4]/Ultima III - Exodus (1986)(Origin)[a4].adf:EXODUS:6:0000
name: run_game_state_loop
description: Initialises the game's state fields and then runs an input-driven loop that updates position and frame values and dispatches on the current state. Several of its paths end in an endless loop, and the decompiler could not recover all of its jump tables.

key: ultima iii - exodus (1986)(origin)[a4]/Ultima III - Exodus (1986)(Origin)[a4].adf:EXODUS:6:01DC
name: wait_for_key_code
description: Polls an input record until one of two key codes arrives, counting down a timer byte on each pass. When the timer goes negative it stops in an endless loop.

key: ultima iii - exodus (1986)(origin)[a4]/Ultima III - Exodus (1986)(Origin)[a4].adf:EXODUS:6:022E
name: select_frame_and_move
description: Chooses a sprite frame code from the current direction and figure type, then runs a loop that reads a key code and moves the position fields by one step, wrapping within 64, for the matching direction keys.

key: ultima iii - exodus (1986)(origin)[a4]/Ultima III - Exodus (1986)(Origin)[a4].adf:EXODUS:6:03A8
name: dispatch_on_direction_state
description: Branches on a direction state byte to one of several update paths, each making a few routine calls. Some paths return through an empty stub when nothing applies.

name: toggle_flag_bit_one

key: ultima iii - exodus (1986)(origin)[a4]/Ultima III - Exodus (1986)(Origin)[a4].adf:EXODUS:6:04D6
name: toggle_flag_bit_two
description: Flips bit value 2 in the program state and then calls a routine.

key: ultima iii - exodus (1986)(origin)[a4]/Ultima III - Exodus (1986)(Origin)[a4].adf:EXODUS:6:057C

name: call_direction_update_routines

name: call_pair_of_routines

name: copy_stored_bytes_to_buffer
